notes.title: UI Update
notes.notes:
May 15th, 2025
⚙ Changes
🛠 Fixes
💙 Buffs
💔 Nerfs

[h2]⚙ General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]🛠 Fixed bug where menus that weren't supposed to allow scrolling would still scroll if you used keyboard or controller controls
[*]🛠 Fixed mistake where "Quit to menu" option said "Exit to main"
[*]⚙ Removed "Reduced Motion" option because its effects have been implemented into the main game
[*]⚙ Redesigned color select
[*]⚙ Removed "Press Start" and "Join Game" text from main menu
[/list]

[h2]Character Select[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341861/4a09a12a2015b6ca5ad5ff448e34692e16f00513.png[/img]
[list]
[*]⚙ Redesigned character select screen
[*]⚙ Added playstyle indicator
[/list]

[h2]Stage Select[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341861/30781dfeb9bd5aac546fcffb66b2dd6138584642.png[/img]
[list]
[*]⚙ Redesigned stage select (now with mouse support)
[/list]

[h2]In Game UI[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341861/90a24f7781e838718221263989e3fa4d8cb10c5c.png[/img]
[list]
[*]⚙ Redesigned in-game health and meter UI
[*]⚙ Redesigned combo counter
[*]⚙ Redesigned style ranks to match new combo counter
[*]⚙ Changed burst indicator to be a square icon
[*]⚙ Added icons that show your special moves and what directional inputs you need to perform them
[*]⚙ Updated character portraits for Cyanide and Mercury to be higher resolution
[/list]

[h2]⚙ New Mods[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341861/320c4495ce13cd3090beb3023b4eeec35b5521c9.png[/img]
[list]
[*]⚙ Improved mod support
[*]⚙ Added mods menu
[/list]

[h3]Light Colors[/h3]

Makes all of the colors lighter and less saturated. Looks less pretty but might be a bit less hard on the eyes.

[h3]Dual Cyanide Menu Background[/h3]

Changes the background of the menu to be Cyanide drawn by Dual Drawn.

[h3]Metallic Names[/h3]

Returns the nametags to their shiny metallic style that they used to have in previous updates.

[h3]Ability Names[/h3]

Displays the name of each ability underneath its icon.
[quote]
WARNING
If you want to make a mod for the game, do not create it inside the game folder. Anything in the game's folder will be deleted when you update.
[/quote]
[quote]
TIP
Instead, make the mod folder somewhere else on your computer, and then add its filepath to the "Mods.txt" in the game folder. Then you can go into the game and enable it from the mods menu.
[/quote]
[quote]
WARNING
Some mod effects might require you to restart your game for them to take effect.
[/quote]

[h2]⚙ Gallery[/h2]
[list]
[*]⚙ Added new gallery image by MattTheGamer172
[/list]

[h2]⚙ Cyanide[/h2]
[list]
[*]⚙ Re-animated some of Cyanide's attacks.
[*]⚙ The newly-changed attacks each now hit 3 times.
[/list]

[h2]⚙ Mercury[/h2]
[list]
[*]⚙ Mercury has a new Reverse Damage Falloff mechanic that's unique to him.
[/list]

[h2]💝 Special Thanks[/h2]
[list]
[*]SpadeInTheDirt for introducing me to Overwatch 2 which finally made me decide to add the ability icons.
[/list]

[h2]⚠ Looking for feedback on[/h2]
[list]
[*]Everything
[/list]
[quote]
[!warning]
This update might come with performance issues. These will be fixed in due time.
[/quote]

notes.title: Jiggle Physics Nerf
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
⚙ Changes
🛠 Fixes
💙 Buffs
💔 Nerfs
[h2] ⚙ General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] ⚙ Reduced ground bounce time to 0.5 seconds.
[*] ⚙ Decreased universal health from 30,000 to 22,500.
[*] ⚙ Made the AI opponent less aggressive.
[/list]
[h2] 🛠 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🛠 Blood Rush aura will no longer appear for characters who are tagged out.
[*] 🛠 Round start and Heartbreak UI now properly shows the colors of player 1 and 2.
[/list]
[h2] 💔 Mercury[/h2]
[list]
[*] 💔 Decreased power level of most attacks to make damage more comparable to Cyanide's.
[*] 💔 Made all normal attacks slower.
[*] 💔 Made Dragon Slash start slower.
[/list]
[h2] 💙 Cyanide[/h2]
[h3] General[/h3]
[list]
[*] 💔 Slowed all of Cyanide's attacks.
[/list]
[h3] Rage[/h3]
[list]
[*] 💙 Increased Cyanide's base rage value 50>100
[*] 💙 Increased Cyanide's Blood Rush rage value 100>300
[/list]
[h3] Teleport[/h3]
[list]
[*] 💔 Added 10 frame startup to Cyanide's teleport.
[*] 💙 Removed slow motion effect from Cyanide's teleport.
[/list]
[h3] Animation Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] 💔 Removed first frame of Cyanide's "Idle" animation to make boob physics look less exaggerated. This has makes the animation look less silly as a spectator but is a downgrade to game feel.
[*] 💙 Added one frame of animation at the start of Cyanide's "Hurt Air" animation. I did this because the first frame is shown during hitstop and the existing first frame looks really extreme for how long it's held. This improves the game's look without sacrificing game feel.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341861/a51faa8b26fd6fed32fa5731ee42817814324e9c.png[/img]

notes.title: Cyanide Teleport Rework
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
+ indicates a buff.
- indicates a nerf.
= indicates a change.
[h2]Global Change[/h2]
[list]
[*] + Increased hitstun to a universal 1 second
[*] - Groundbounce no longer resets the Infinite Prevention System
[/list]
[h2]Cyanide[/h2]
[list]
[*] = Updated teleport animation to use dash sprite.
[*] = Teleporting straight up, down, or neutral, will now also move your forward, and trigger Blood Rush.
[*] + Teleporting behind the opponent during a combo will now slash through them on the way.
[/list]
